text:
Maya P: Heads-up — vendor just flagged a hold on one rack allocation for our EU private pilot. ETA moved from May 2 -> May 16. We have a demo next week. Need to decide whether to: release warm capacity to other marketplace customers, accept a paid priority to keep it, or fall back to hosted for the demo. cc @Sam W @Arjun K
Sam W: Ugh. Do we know why it's on hold? customs, manifest, or hardware QC?
Ben (OrionSI): Partner update: it's a customs paperwork delay — missing broker signature. We can escalate to courier for an expedited release but need your approval to change delivery terms (DDP) and sign an SLA amendment for priority handling.
Arjun K: If we switch to DDP that shifts cost and liability to us, but it does shorten lead time. What's the price delta for the expedited service?
Ben (OrionSI): Priority handling + expedited courier = +$4,000 for the rack, ETA could move to May 9 if paperwork is cleared by EOD tomorrow. Without that, next available is May 16 due to port backlog.
Lena H: If we push this rack to the marketplace, our pilot demo will miss the window and engineering won't have physical infra for the on-prem tests. Demo risk is medium-high. Hosted fallback would preserve demo but affects fidelity of on-prem tests.
Maya P: Options I'm laying out: 1) Accept priority SLA + DDP (+$4k) to get rack by May 9. 2) Reassign rack to marketplace customers and reschedule pilot to May 20+. 3) Use hosted Dedicated burst for demo (higher runtime costs, preserves timeline). Which do we prefer for product/PS commitments?
Sam W: For customer confidence, demo timeline is highest priority. I'd prefer option 1 if procurement/legal can sign quickly, otherwise option 3 as fallback for the demo only.
Arjun K: I'll draft a short SLA addendum that limits our liability and sets clear acceptance criteria for the rack. Also confirm: do we want the partner to ship only one rack with expedited courier (partial release) or the whole shipment?
Ben (OrionSI): We can do a partial release — prioritize shipment of 1 rack and leave remainder on standard manifest. Partial release works with courier but still requires DDP incoterm on that PO line.
Maya P: Good. Arjun, please draft the amendment and include the PO line change to DDP for 1 rack. Also coordinate with finance for the +$4k approval. Sam, spin up hosted burst for the demo and attach the demo cluster details in the runbook. I'll ping legal and finance now.
Arjun K: Drafted snippet for the SLA amendment below, will expand and share doc link shortly:
```
SLA Addendum: Priority Customs Facilitation
- Service: Expedited customs clearance + courier pickup for PO <PO#>.
- Incoterm: DDP for Line Item 1 (1x rack).
- Cost: +$4,000 one-time surcharge.
- ETA target: Carrier pickup within 24h of signed addendum; delivery target May 9 contingent on paperwork.
- Liability: Vendor retains hardware warranty; Redwood covers customs duties and expedited courier fees for the prioritised line.
- Termination: If customs not cleared within 72h of signed addendum, Redwood may cancel priority and request marketplace reallocation.
```
Lena H: That covers the key points. Add a clause requiring a manifest and carrier tracking number before Redwood authorizes courier payment.
Arjun K: Added that clause in my doc, linking file: https://redwood.internal/docs/sla-addendum/3532109876 (will update with final language).
Maya P: Finance says they can greenlight up to $5k for operational escalations with approval from Sam. Sam, can you confirm?
Sam W: Confirmed. Finance approved $4k for the priority shipment.
Maya P: Great. Ben, if we sign the amendment today and move to DDP + courier, please confirm you can provide manifest + tracking before courier leaves port. Also confirm that partial release won't trigger penalties on the remaining units.
Ben (OrionSI): Confirmed — we can provide manifest + tracking pre-pickup. Partial release will not incur penalties; remainder will ship on standard manifest. Courier ETA May 9 if paperwork clears.
OrionPartnerBot: Courier system: expedited pickup available. ETA projection May 9 (subject to customs clearance flag).
Maya P: OK — plan: sign SLA addendum today, change PO line to DDP for 1 rack, finance will charge the +$4k, Arjun will post final addendum link, Sam will spin up hosted burst for demo. If customs fails to clear by EOD tomorrow we fallback to reassign marketplace and reschedule pilot. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
